title: ak update --json (update-v1)
description: One ak update run: what each requested CLI's vendor discovery found, what was installed, what PATH resolves afterwards, and whether the pin moved. Additive within interface 1: new fields may appear, existing ones do not change meaning.

kit.description: The kit version that performed the run.

cli.description: The canonical CLI name (kind names resolve to it).

from_pin.description: The version providers.toml pinned before this run (empty when none).

to_version.description: The version discovered, or named with --version; null when discovery did not run or failed.

resolution.description: What PATH resolves after the run; empty when nothing is installed or the run stopped before an install.

pin_written.description: True when providers.toml was re-pinned to to_version (a providers.toml.bak is kept first).

status.description: updated: installed and PATH resolves it. current: PATH already resolved it, at most the pin moved. skipped: nothing done (no vendor discovery, a refusal, a shadowed install). failed: an error; the pin is unchanged unless the note says otherwise.

note.description: Human-readable detail: what moved, what was taken over, why nothing was.
